note: Legend portraits, the veteran (Lead via Strategy, Dom 2026-09-27). One FLUX.1 [dev] text-to-image per rung, from the source text in src/legends.ts; never from a film, comic or game depiction. Final size 512x512. `style` is appended to every subject. The prompt is `framing` + `subject` + `style`.
framing: Close-up head-and-shoulders portrait, the face large and filling the upper half of the square frame, cropped at the chest, of
style: Dark painterly realism like an old oil painting, ancient brutal ceremonial tone, grounded proportions, muted palette of bronze, iron, bone, leather, stone and ash, a single low warm torchlight from one side leaving the rest in deep shadow, dark smoky near-black background, no saturated colours, no glowing effects, no text, no border, no frame.

legends.name: Marcus the Recruit
legends.subject: a young Roman legionary recruit, a farm boy with a sunburnt nervous face and cropped hair, a plain bronze Montefortino helmet slightly too big for him, a coarse red wool tunic and new leather straps, blistered hands on a shield rim.

legends.name: Titus Pullo
legends.subject: Titus Pullo, a battle-hardened Roman centurion of Caesar's Gallic legions, broad weathered face with a broken nose and fierce grin, iron mail shirt, transverse crested helmet, blood and mud on his cheek.

legends.name: Lucius Vorenus
legends.subject: Lucius Vorenus, a disciplined Roman centurion of Caesar's Gallic legions, lean stern face with a short dark beard, iron mail shirt with bronze phalerae medals, transverse crested helmet, steady wary eyes.

legends.name: Horatius Cocles
legends.subject: Horatius Cocles, an early Roman warrior soaked from the Tiber, dripping hair and beard, dented archaic bronze helmet and round shield, the ruined timbers of a bridge behind him, unyielding stare.

legends.name: Cincinnatus
legends.subject: Cincinnatus, a grey-haired Roman farmer-dictator, weathered stern face, a plain white wool toga pulled over a farmer's tunic, a wooden plough handle and field behind him.

legends.name: Scipio Africanus
legends.subject: Scipio Africanus, a clean-shaven Roman general in his prime, calm intelligent face, a muscled bronze cuirass and a red general's cloak, the dust of a North African battlefield behind him.

legends.name: Leonidas
legends.subject: Leonidas king of Sparta, a grizzled bearded warrior, a bronze Corinthian helmet pushed up on his head, a heavy crimson cloak, a bronze-faced hoplite shield with a lambda, a narrow rocky mountain pass behind him.

legends.name: Alexander
legends.subject: Alexander of Macedon, a young clean-shaven king with a lion's mane of tousled hair and an upward intense gaze, a bronze and linen cuirass with a gorgon head, a Macedonian cloak.

legends.name: Julius Caesar
legends.subject: Julius Caesar, a lean balding Roman with a hard intelligent face and deep lines, a laurel wreath, a general's red cloak over a bronze cuirass, a cold decisive stare.

legends.name: Mars
legends.subject: Mars the Roman god of war as in ancient Roman statues, a bearded muscular man in a tall crested Attic bronze helmet, a bronze cuirass, a spear and wolf at his side, stern and terrible.
